LAB RESULT COMMENT TO THE PATIENT Swan River Children's Health Service, General Paediatrics Result released: 12/05/2095 (Thursday 12 May) Patient: Jakub Wisniewski-Hart UR JW 1409-78 DOB 14/09/2078 Age: 16 Tests collected: 09/05/2095 (full blood count, haemoglobin, white cell count) Requested by: Dr Callum Strathairn Sent to: Kuba via the youth portal (https://myhealth.swanriver.example/y/kuba1409) and by post to 17 Banksia Rise, Mount Lawley WA 6050; copy to mum Eleanor.
Dear Kuba,
Your blood tests from Monday are normal. Your white blood cell count and haemoglobin are both in the normal range for your age, so there is no sign of anaemia or infection, and that is what we hoped to see. The questionnaire you filled out the same day about mood and worry shows that things are quite a bit better than at your 2094 visit, which I am pleased about. You told me you are still doing the skateboarding, and I will say as your doctor to please wear the helmet and wrist guards.
You were also referred to the dentist for gum bleeding, an appointment with Dr Bao Tran-Okeke at Lawley Family Dental is for Monday 23/05/2095 (that was entered as 23/05/2059 in the booking, which is a mistake). Bring this letter. If anything changes please call 0400 555 014 or message on the portal.
Kind regards, Callum Strathairn Consultant Paediatrician
